999008199.text:
さーて、予選が終わり夜になりました！
本選は翌日からの開始となります！

localizations.en: Well then, the qualifiers are over and night has fallen! The main races will begin tomorrow!

999008199.text:
レースは一時中断となりますが、夜も様々な
出し物があります。ぜひ楽しんでいってください

localizations.en: The races are temporarily suspended, but there are various entertainment options throughout the night. Please enjoy yourselves!

999008199.text:
みんな、予選は勝ち抜いたみたいね。
ま、こんなので私たちが負けるなんて思ってないけど

localizations.en: Looks like everyone made it through the qualifiers. Well, I never thought we'd lose to something like this anyway.

999008199.text:
うん。鶏肉はもう目の前ってこと。
どうしよう、もうお腹が空いてきたわ

localizations.en: Yeah. The chicken's practically within reach. Oh no, I'm getting hungry already.

999008199.text:
もう勝った気でいるの……？
手を抜くつもりはないわ

localizations.en: You're already acting like you've won...? I have no intention of holding back.

999008199.text: 油断大敵、最後まで気を抜いちゃダメだよヴァレリア！

localizations.en: Never let your guard down! You can't get careless until the very end, Valeria!

999008199.text:
あたしたちのことを忘れてもらっちゃ困るよ。
やるからには１位を目指すからね、クラウディア

localizations.en: Don't forget about us either. If we're gonna do this, we're aiming for first place, right Klaudia?

999008199.text: もう。賞品に興味なんてないんでしょ、ライザは

localizations.en: Oh, come on. You're not even interested in the prize, are you Ryza?

999008199.text:
みんな好き勝手言ってるけど、１位の座は
私のものよ！　圧倒的大差で勝ってやるんだから！

localizations.en: Everyone's talking big, but first place is mine! I'm gonna win by an overwhelming margin!

999008199.text:
とは言っても、このレース……。
突拍子もないことばかり起きてる気がする

localizations.en: That said, this race... It feels like all sorts of unexpected things keep happening.

999008199.text:
ぷにとか、ウサギとかのこと？
確かに気になるよね

localizations.en: You mean the Punis and rabbits? Yeah, that is pretty weird.

999008199.text:
どーせ、盛り上げるためとか言って
ララの奴が何か仕込んでるんでしょ

localizations.en: I bet Lara's behind it all, probably set something up to make things more exciting.

999008199.text:
あら、心外ですわ。
そんな無粋なこと、わたくしはしませんわよ

localizations.en: My, how insulting. I would never do anything so tasteless.

999008199.text: ララさん！　お仕事お疲れさまです！

localizations.en: Miss Lara! Thanks for all your hard work!

999008199.text:
あんたの仕業じゃないっていうなら、
あれはただの事故だったっていうわけ？

localizations.en: If it's not your doing, then you're saying all that stuff was just accidents?

999008199.text:
そうは見えませんわね。
何者かの企みに違いありませんわ

localizations.en: That hardly seems likely. It must be someone's scheme.

999008199.text: 何者かって……誰よ！

こんなことをするのは一人しかいないでしょう。
クリセルダですわ

localizations.en: There's only one person who would do such a thing. Criselda.

999008199.text:
あいつが！？　なに考えてるわけ！？
見かけたらただじゃおかないわ

localizations.en: That woman?! What's she thinking?! I won't let her get away with it if I see her!

999008199.text:
わたくしからも言い聞かせるつもりですわ。
本選では妨害させませんから、安心しなさいな

localizations.en: I intend to have words with her myself. I won't let her interfere with the main races, so rest assured.

999008199.text: それよりも、夜の出し物も楽しんでらっしゃい

localizations.en: More importantly, do enjoy the evening entertainment.

999008199.text:
歌姫の歌を聞きながら光で照らされた
海を眺めるのも、乙なものですわよ

localizations.en: Listening to a diva's song while gazing at the illuminated sea is quite the elegant experience.

999008199.text: おお、楽しそう！　行ってみよう、みんな！

localizations.en: Ooh, that sounds fun! Let's go check it out, everyone!

999008199.text: はい！　先輩、お供いたします！

localizations.en: Yes! I'll come with you, Miss Ryza!
